university.history: Originally established as BZU Bahadur Sub-Campus Layyah in 2009. Upgraded to a full independent university in December 2022. It is the only public university in the Layyah region, serving southern Punjab.

how_to_apply: Step 1: Visit the official admission portal at eportal.ul.edu.pk/admissions
Step 2: Select your desired Program Category
Step 3: Register using your Email and CNIC number
Step 4: Fill in your personal information, academic details, and program preferences
Step 5: Upload scanned copies of required documents
Step 6: Pay the application fee via Bank Challan
Step 7: Submit the application and note your Application ID
Step 8: Check the university website and notice board for merit lists
Step 9: If selected, complete enrollment by paying the semester fee within the given deadline
required_documents: Matriculation (SSC) Certificate and Detailed Marks Sheet
Intermediate (HSSC) Certificate and Detailed Marks Sheet

scholarships.eligibility: Students from low-income families enrolled in recognized universities

scholarships.name: Punjab Educational Endowment Fund (PEEF)
scholarships.eligibility: Punjab domicile holders with financial need and good academic record

scholarships.name: University of Layyah Internal Merit Scholarship
scholarships.eligibility: Students who secure top positions / distinctions in their batch at UL
scholarships.apply_at: Automatically awarded based on academic performance each semester

assessment_breakdown.note: Assessment breakdown follows HEC-standard Uniform Examination Policy

grading_system.minimum_cgpa_to_continue: 2.0 (students below this are placed on academic probation)
grading_system.maximum_duration_BS: 6 years to complete a 4-year BS degree
grading_system.semester_freeze: Freezing of first two semesters of BS is not allowed

attendance_policy.minimum_attendance: 75% of total lectures per course per semester
attendance_policy.consequence: Students with less than 75% attendance in a course will be debarred from appearing in the final examination of that course
attendance_policy.medical_leave: Must submit a doctor's certificate to the department within 3 working days of returning

exam_rules: Students must carry their University ID Card to all examinations — no ID means no entry
Mobile phones and electronic devices are strictly prohibited in the examination hall
No student is allowed to enter the examination hall 30 minutes after the exam has started
Students must maintain complete silence during examinations
Any form of cheating, copying, or unfair means results in immediate cancellation of the exam and disciplinary action
Assignments and coursework must be submitted by the announced deadline; late submissions may receive reduced marks or zero
Mid-semester exams are typically held in Week 8–9 of each semester
Final exams are held at the end of each semester as per the university examination schedule

campus_facilities.hostels: Limited hostel facility available. Contact Student Affairs for availability.
campus_facilities.transport: Transport routes available for select areas. Contact Student Affairs for current route details.

conduct_rules: Maintain a respectful and professional environment at all times
Dress code: Formal or semi-formal attire expected on campus
University ID card must be carried at all times on campus
Students are responsible for the care and upkeep of university property
Ragging of any form is strictly prohibited and punishable under university regulations and the law
Smoking and use of any prohibited substance is not allowed on university premises
Mobile phones must be on silent or switched off during classes and examinations
student_support: Student Affairs Office for general queries and grievances
Library access for research and self-study

annual_events: Orientation Week for new students at the start of each semester
World Environment Day activities (Faculty of Agriculture)
regular_activities: Weekly seminars and guest lectures by industry experts
Community service and social welfare initiatives
Workshops on professional skills and entrepreneurship
